migration_objective: Replace RSA wrapping with ML-KEM encapsulation and context-bound HKDF key derivation without changing authenticated job encryption.
preconditions: Use synthetic print-job bytes and fictional identities.
The current cryptographic baseline is preserved in src/secureprint/crypto.py.
expected_behavior: Preserve printer authorization and job lifecycle behavior.
Reject malformed inputs and cryptographic tampering.
migration_requirements: Use the pinned standardized PQC APIs; do not implement primitives.
Keep signing and key-establishment keys separate.
Maintain explicit serialization and compatibility behavior.
verification_procedure: Run the SecurePrint original and PQC test suites.
Verify positive round trips and negative tamper, malformed-key, and signature cases where applicable.
known_limitations: Not independently reviewed or production security certified.
The local simulation uses in-memory state and process-ephemeral keys.
